title: Cat Crosshair
description: a simple cat crosshair for cat lovers
body:
**🐾 Cat Crosshair
By JustNaxu**

Tired of the standard, bulky Minecraft crosshair? Upgrade your HUD with the Cat Crosshair! This lightweight resource pack replaces the default center cross with an adorable, minimalist cat silhouette, giving your screen a unique touch.

![cat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aae2449615497ab33623abfed42e7c57d8475edf_0.webp)

✨ Features
Custom Feline Design: A pixel-perfect, minimalist cat shape that seamlessly replaces the default vanilla crosshair.

Optimized Scaling: Carefully sized and positioned to remain crisp and perfectly centered on your screen.

Broad Compatibility: Programmed to support a wide range of Minecraft updates out of the box, from older versions up to the latest releases.

🎮 How It Improves Your Experience
Unobstructed Vision: The sleek, hollowed-out design reduces screen clutter. Unlike the thick default cross, it allows you to see exactly what you are aiming at without blocking the center of your screen.

Cozy Personalization: It adds a fun, aesthetic vibe to your daily adventures, making your HUD feel customized and unique to your playstyle.

**Feel free to check out my profile for more custom HUDs and texture packs, including my Alya (Roshidere) theme, and my new haimiya totem texturepack.**
